summary: Frontend bug/lag sweep completed on Taher Ali Enterprises B2B site. Verified all 10 retail product cards render with real customer-assets images (no broken URLs, zero 4xx/5xx image responses). Product Detail (p1) shows exactly one main image, no thumbnail strip, sticky bar uses real image and qty/total math is correct (₹89×3=₹267). Cart, WhatsApp checkout deep-link, wholesale quantity dialog (presets 20/50/100 + Custom + min-10 note), search, theme toggle (light↔dark), and mobile 390px viewport all functional. Related products carousel renders MiniCards with real images. No horizontal scroll on mobile. WhatsApp URL is well-formed with 916305486808 and encoded order details.

ui_bugs.issue: In Custom qty mode, entering a value below 10 (e.g. 5) shows the 'minimum 10 units' hint but the confirm 'Add to Cart' button remains enabled (not disabled). Item does not actually get added to cart on click (silent block), which is confusing UX — button should be visibly disabled or should surface an inline error toast.

issues: Contrast bump to text-gray-{700,800} is applied consistently across Home, Products, Product Detail, Wholesale — readability good in both light and dark modes. 'Our Promise' banner labels (Hygienic Facility / Honest Pricing) render readable on green banner.

console_warnings.issue: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from WholesaleProductsPage.jsx line 152 (SORT_OPTIONS select). Caused by dev-instrumentation wrapping option label text in a <span data-ve-dynamic>. Does not break functionality but pollutes console and is a real HTML spec violation. Consider rendering plain string children in <option> (avoid any wrapping component/span in option labels).
